Tried to break: a v2 record written, then the host downgraded to a v1 reader — `v: 2 !== 1` → no choice, symmetric and safe. **`RelatedCardMenu.tsx` — `RelatedPanelHandle` (keyboard reorder).** ⌥↑ / ⌥↓ only with `altKey` and no meta / ctrl / shift; `preventDefault` + `stopPropagation`; `onMoveUp` is `undefined` at index 0 and `onMoveDown` at the end (the hook's `chromeOf`), so an edge press is a no-op; the handle's click stops propagation so Enter / Space on it does not open the list; focus is re-sought on the moved panel's handle after a frame, which is needed because the keyed reorder moves the section's DOM node (insertBefore blurs it). `dragHandleProps` is spread last and carries only `draggable` / `onDragStart` / `onDragEnd`, so it cannot overwrite `onKeyDown` / `onClick`. `setDragImage` on the whole panel is guarded for jsdom. Target 11: `compactNameField` fires only when `resolveNameField(objectSchema) === referenceField`; the projection (`compactSelect`) swaps the name field for the chosen column, so the wire read carries it; the row reads `recordDisplayValueAt(row, compactNameField)`, which unwraps a lookup value's `name`. Pinned on both the product page and the opportunity page. Pinned by `record-related-list.emptyPanels-27524` (three cases), and the dev's ablation on the all-empty guard went red on exactly that case. The stack is per container element (`WeakMap` keyed by the slots' `parentElement`, which is the `aside[data-record-column="related"]` of `RecordPageColumns`). Tried to break it: **must-fix (④-1) — the 展开 state leaks across records.** `Stack.expanded` is set `true` by 展开 and is never reset: not when the members change, not when the record changes. `RecordDetailView` keys nothing by record id (`recordId = recordIdOverride ?? params.recordId` on the same instance) and `recordDrawerStack.tsx` keys its level by `${depth}:${objectName}` on purpose ("a step to a sibling swaps the record in place"), so when a reader presses 展开 on contact A in the split pane and steps ↓ to contact B, C, … the same `aside` element, the same `Stack` and its `expanded = true` serve every sibling: their empty panels never fold, and there is no control that folds them again (展开 has no inverse). The same holds on the page wherever the view instance survives a record change. Target 2 rules that empty panels fold into one line; after one 展开 it holds for the rest of the drawer session only by accident of remount. The PR body's own model, "the stack then folds nothing until it is drawn again", is implemented as "until the container element is recreated", which is not a view. Fix, small: scope `expanded` to the record — reset it in `RelatedListStackSlot` when the record context's id changes (or key it by `recordId` in the `Stack`), or key `RelatedCardStack`'s column by the record id — and pin "stepping to a sibling record folds again". With that, the fold design holds.

**`ArrangedRelatedTab.tsx`.** Scope loses `isCollapsed` / `expand`; `chromeOf`, `lastId`, `hiddenCount`, `showHidden`, `defaultChanged`, `restoreDefault` stay; the renderer's collapsed branch and its `CollapsedRelatedCard` node synthesis are gone, the `language` read with them.
